definition: Calendar day (Europe/Paris time zone) on which an event happened; weeks start on Monday
Where a sale happens: Web (leslipfrancais.fr on Shopify), Store (own shops) or Wholesale (Carrefour, Monoprix and other resellers)
A physical place holding stock or selling: the warehouse/factory, each own store; wholesale customers are not locations
A confirmed purchase: a Shopify order, a store ticket or a wholesale order in the ERP; cancelled orders are excluded
One product (SKU) and its quantity inside an order
A company that buys to resell (for example one Carrefour hypermarket); not a person, so not in the golden customer
Stock keeping unit: one product in one size and one colour, identified by its SKU code (shared by Shopify, POS and ERP)
A model sold in several sizes and colours (for example "Le Marius" brief); groups SKUs
Product family: briefs and boxers, socks, pyjamas, T-shirts, accessories
Size label of a SKU (XS to XXL for clothing; size ranges for socks)
Colour label of a SKU
Number of units on an order line; negative for returned units
Quantity x unit price excluding VAT before discounts
Price reduction on an order line excluding VAT (promotion code, sale, wholesale terms)
Gross revenue minus discounts and returns, excluding VAT and shipping fees; the reference figure for sales
Production cost of one unit of a SKU from the ERP (materials + factory labour), excluding VAT
Net revenue minus quantity x unit cost
An order line sent back by the customer; counted on the date the return is received
A Web order the customer collects in a store: it stays in the Web channel, and its location is that store, which gets credit for it
Net revenue divided by number of orders over a period (63 EUR excl. VAT on the web in 2025)
A person who has placed at least one Web or Store order, as known in one source tool
The single record for one real person after matching all source records (Shopify, Klaviyo, POS, Zendesk)
Pseudonymous identifier of a golden customer; the only customer identifier allowed in the marts
Date of the first Web or Store order of a golden customer
Date of the most recent Web or Store order of a golden customer
Number of Web and Store orders of a golden customer
A golden customer with 2 orders or more (42 % of customers in 2025)
Group of customers by Recency, Frequency and Monetary value of their orders over the last 24 months
Whether the person may receive marketing emails/SMS: explicit consent, or the CNIL existing-customer exception; withdrawal always wins
Age grouped in bands (under 25, 25-34, 35-44, 45-54, 55+) instead of birth date
French department (first 2 digits of the postcode) instead of the full address
Date on which a stock level was recorded (one snapshot per week)
Units of a SKU physically available at a location on the snapshot date
Stock on hand divided by average daily units sold over the last 28 days (all channels); in days
Units sold over a period divided by (stock at start of period + units received during it)
A SKU with zero stock on hand at a location while it sold at least one unit in the last 28 days
A SKU whose stock cover is above 180 days
Units of a SKU finished by the factories during the period (from the ERP)
One marketing send in Klaviyo (email or SMS) to a list or segment, with a send date
Number of profiles a campaign was sent to
Unique opens divided by delivered messages of a campaign
Unique clicks divided by delivered messages of a campaign
Net revenue of Web orders placed by recipients within 5 days of clicking a campaign
A visit to the website measured by Google Analytics 4, only for visitors who accepted analytics cookies
Where a session comes from: organic search, paid search, social, email, direct, other
Web orders divided by sessions over a period
Instagram, Facebook or TikTok account of the brand
Likes + comments + shares + saves on the brand's posts, per platform and day
Number of followers of a social account at the end of the day
A customer request in Zendesk (email or chat)
Reason of a ticket: delivery, size/exchange, product quality, payment, other
Hours between ticket creation and the first reply from an agent
Customer satisfaction score given after a ticket is solved (satisfied / not satisfied)
All Web, Store and Wholesale orders with their revenue and margin (the sales mart)
Stock levels, stock movements and production of SKUs per location (the inventory mart)
Campaigns, website traffic and social media results (the marketing mart)
Customer service requests and their handling (the support mart)
Share of website visitors who accepted analytics cookies in the cookie banner, per day; sessions are only measured for them
